Lesson.do_now: Retrieval or spiral warm-up (3–5 problems, ~5 min)
Lesson.notes: New-content notes in the lesson's notes_style (guided fill-in / exploration / pre-filled reference) with 2–3 worked examples
Lesson.practice: Guided 'we do' problems, then independent practice (8–12 new problems, scaffolded easy → challenge)
Lesson.exit_ticket: Summary prompt using the sentence frame + 2–3 exit-ticket problems on today's objective

Practice.do_now: Retrieval warm-up on the lessons being practiced
Practice.notes: Pre-filled reference sheet / anchor chart of covered lessons (no new content)
Practice.practice: Tiered practice sets or stations (Level 1/2/3) + error-analysis problem
Practice.exit_ticket: Self-assessment by lesson + 2 mixed exit-ticket problems

Quiz.do_now: Light confidence warm-up (1–2 problems) or none
Quiz.practice: Mid-unit quiz (10–15 items) on lessons_covered; early finishers: enrichment
Quiz.exit_ticket: Quiz reflection: 'Which problem was hardest and why?'

Review.notes: Pre-filled unit summary / study guide with blank 'my example' spaces
Review.practice: Review stations, game, or practice test covering every unit lesson
Review.exit_ticket: Unit self-assessment checklist (I can… statements) + 1 problem per weak area

Assessment.practice: Unit test covering all lessons_covered; include multiple choice, constructed response, and one modeling task
Assessment.exit_ticket: Post-test reflection: confidence rating per topic

Flex.do_now: Spiral warm-up targeting most-missed test items
Flex.notes: Short targeted reteach mini-lessons for small groups (based on data)
Flex.practice: Test corrections + tiered reteach (Tier 1) and enrichment/extension (Tier 2–3)
Flex.exit_ticket: Correction reflection: 'My error was ___. The correct approach is ___.'

Diagnostic.practice: Diagnostic pre-assessment of pre-algebra readiness skills

Exam Review.notes: Pre-filled cumulative review guide for the listed units
Exam Review.practice: Mixed cumulative practice / stations across the listed units

Project.do_now: Project check-in / goal for the day
